data.name: Vanlal
data.long_meaning: The name Vanlal is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two parts. The first part, 'Van', means 'forest' or 'jungle'. The second part, 'Lal', means 'good fortune'. Thus, the name Vanlal signifies someone who brings good fortune from the forest or jungle.

The name Vanlal reflects this spiritual connection and suggests that the person named after this name is someone who can bring blessings and good fortune from this sacred place.
